visual_action: A blurry close-up shot of Donald Trump in a dark suit and a purple tie. He is looking down, and his right hand is held against his stomach, showing what appear to be red marks or sores on the back of his hand. Text appears overlaid on this image throughout the clip.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: He is the only person shown in the video, and the audio voiceover speaks from his imagined perspective.

cast.name: Democratic Party
cast.evidence: The video was posted by the official @democrats account.

spoken_summary: A deep, distorted male voice, speaking in the first person as if it were Donald Trump, lists negative attributes, saying, "I am not cute. I am not beautiful. I am not intelligent. I am not perfect."
audio_music: A dramatic, orchestral version of the song "Carol of the Bells" by Lindsey Stirling plays throughout, creating a serious and ominous tone. A deep, distorted voiceover is layered on top of the music.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static, blurry shot of Donald Trump. The only editing is the sequential appearance and disappearance of text overlays.
central_claim: Donald Trump is a flawed individual who is not cute, beautiful, intelligent, or perfect.
intended_effect: To portray Donald Trump in a negative light and encourage viewers to see him as inadequate.
